children: Best Buy Co. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $9.78B, up 3.6% from $9.44B a year earlier, and diluted earnings per share of $1.48 versus $0.87 in the prior-year quarter; net income rose to $315M from $186M.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net earnings”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.

Revenue growth was driven by the Domestic segment and a continued shift to omnichannel sales, with online representing about 33% of Domestic revenue and comparable online sales up roughly 5.1% in the quarter.
Category momentum included computing, mobile, home theater, AI glasses and trading cards; Marketplace and Best Buy Ads also contributed to higher gross profit rates.
Operational efficiency improved due to Marketplace/Ads mix, tariff refunds and lower restructuring charges, which helped lift operating margins.
Best Buy continued to optimize its store footprint, with 926 Domestic stores after pruning, modest planned expansion of two Best Buy stores, and ongoing lease optimization.
